changes.title: Retarget profile(s) 'Default' from 'All users' to a group without admins
changes.rationale: Entra allows a passkey if any scoped profile allows it, so a loose profile on a target that contains admins overrides their strict profile.
notes: The proposed group is a static snapshot. In production, keep it current with a dynamic membership rule or by excluding your role-assignable admin groups from it.

changes.title: Scope privileged users to 'Admins - device-bound'
changes.rationale: Every admin should be scoped to the strict profile, and only to it.
notes: Prefer targeting your existing role-assignable admin group instead of this snapshot group.

changes.title: Point the registration campaign at passkeys for all users, with limited snoozes
changes.rationale: 3 SMS/voice-only user(s) need a nudge before their deadline.
notes: Check the targetedAuthenticationMethod value your tenant's Graph version accepts.

changes.title: Require 'Admins - device-bound keys only' for admins on all apps
changes.rationale: Conditional Access must be satisfied by every applicable policy, so one strict policy closes the sign-in gap left by plain MFA or the built-in phishing-resistant strength (which accepts synced passkeys).
notes: Roll out in report-only first and check sign-in logs for admins without an approved key.
Emergency-access accounts are left out on purpose; protect them separately.

changes.title: Exclude admins from Temporary Access Pass and make TAP single-use, 60 minutes
changes.rationale: Anyone who can issue an admin a TAP can register a passkey on that account.
notes: Issue admin TAPs only through a documented, two-person process, by temporarily removing the admin from this group.

changes.title: Replace 'CA exclusions (legacy apps)' with a role-assignable group
changes.rationale: Only Privileged Role Administrators can change a role-assignable group, so owners and Groups Administrators can no longer move admins in or out of policy scope.
notes: isAssignableToRole can only be set when a group is created, so this is a new group.

changes.title: Complete the authentication methods migration
changes.rationale: Legacy MFA and SSPR settings keep governing SMS and voice until the migration is marked complete.
notes: Check that the methods policy enables everything users rely on before you complete it.
